note: Basis Set Exchange records vendored verbatim for lab/md.js; sha256 is over the stored bytes, whose numbers are the BSE decimal strings. Recomputed 2026-09-12. The STO-3G record was WIDENED 2026-09-12 from H, Li-F to H-Kr (elements 1-36) for lab/molecules.js; the H and Li-F electron_shells are byte-identical decimals in both records, so every energy pinned before the widening is unchanged (proved to 1e-12 by tests/md.test.mjs, tests/rhf-molecules.test.mjs and tests/molecule-state.test.mjs).

records.name: STO-3G
records.widened: 2026-09-12: H, Li-F -> H-Kr. The superseded hash is the H, Li-F record; its shells are a byte-identical subset of this one.

records.name: 6-31+G*
records.note: oxygen shell order in the record is s(6), sp(3), sp(1), d(1), sp(1) diffuse - the diffuse shell follows the polarisation shell, so md.js sorts by l per atom to reach PySCF's AO order
records.widened: 2026-09-18: H, O -> H, C, N, O, F. The superseded hash is the H, O record; the H and O electron_shells are byte-identical decimals in both, so the pinned water energy -76.017441376748 is unchanged. Nineteen library molecules agree with PySCF cart=True on these decimals to 3e-12 (lab/oracles/6-31+g-star-v1.json).
